The '''Agitator''' was a model of personal [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] produced by [[Lergo]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The pilot was situated over a trio of turbine-like engines that were all directed towards the ground.
